Privacy Policy — Vendor app

Last updated: September 15, 2026

AbhiRam FreshMart ("we", "us") operates the AbhiRam Fresh Mart Vendor app, used by partner stores to manage their catalog and fulfil customer orders. This policy explains what information the app collects, why, and how you can control it.

Information we collect

Account details: your name, phone number and/or email address. Vendor accounts are set up by our admin team when your store joins the platform, rather than self-registration; you sign in with the credentials we issue you.

Shop details: your store name, category, address and map location, operating hours, delivery radius, and accepting-orders status.

Catalog data: the products you list — names, prices, stock levels, units, categories, and any photos you upload.

Order data: for orders placed at your store, the customer's name, phone number, delivery address, and the items ordered — shown to you only so you can prepare and hand off the order.

Sales and performance data: revenue, order counts, and product-level stats computed from your own store's order history.

Device and notification data: a push-notification token so we can alert you of new orders and status changes, plus basic technical data such as app version and connection status.

Support requests: anything you submit through in-app support or contact us directly about.

How we use this information

To authenticate you and secure your vendor account.

To let you manage your catalog, pricing, stock, and store settings.

To route incoming customer orders to your store and let you accept, reject, or mark them ready.

To notify you of new orders and order-status changes in real time.

To show you analytics about your own store's sales and performance.

To provide support and respond to issues you report.

Sharing with third parties

Delivery partners assigned to an order see the customer's delivery details and order contents needed to complete that delivery — not your account credentials or other stores' data.

Your shop's public details (name, location, product catalog, ratings) are shown to customers browsing the marketplace, since that's the purpose of the platform.

Service providers who process data on our behalf, such as our cloud image hosting provider (for product/shop photos) and push-notification service. They only receive what's needed to perform their service.

We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it with advertisers.

Your choices

Store visibility: you can pause new orders or update your hours and delivery radius at any time from Settings.

Notifications: order-alert sound and push notifications can be adjusted in Settings.

Data export, corrections, or account deletion: since vendor accounts are provisioned by our admin team rather than self-service signup, contact us at abhiramfreshmartvmr@gmail.com (or your account contact) to request a data export, correction, or deletion of your vendor account and associated data.

Data retention

We keep your account, catalog, and order data for as long as your store is active on the platform, and for a limited period after deactivation where we're legally required to (for example, transaction records for tax purposes).

Children's privacy

This app is intended for store owners and staff aged 18 and over, and we do not knowingly collect data from children.

Security

We use industry-standard measures (such as encrypted connections and access controls) to protect your information, though no method of transmission or storage is ever 100% secure.

Changes to this policy

If we make material changes, we'll update the "last updated" date above and, where required, notify you in the app.

Contact us
